task: Constrain ultralight boson mass and self-interaction coupling from BH posterior samples via Bayesian superradiance framework
named_methods: Black hole superradiance (Penrose process) for massive bosons
Detweiler analytic Gamma_SR for alpha << 1 in l=m=1 mode

primary_outputs.mu_excluded_intervals: Upper/lower bounds on excluded ULB mass intervals at 68% and 95% credibility
primary_outputs.f_a_lower_bound: Lower bound on the decay constant f_a (where Bosenova kills SR)
primary_outputs.exclusion_contours: P_excl(mu) and 2D contour in (mu, f_a) plane

fidelity_axes: Use full posterior, not just point estimate
Cover both stellar and supermassive regimes
Report both per-source and combined constraints
Apply the SR condition omega < m Omega_H, AND require tau_SR < tau_BH
Include Bosenova for the f_a constraint
limitations: Detweiler small-alpha expansion is approximate; use it as standard in the literature for alpha<=0.5
BH age tau_BH is not fully observationally tied; use canonical Salpeter time for SMBH and stellar evolution age range for M33 X-7
